doc_title_en: Notice on Revision of Consolidated Financial Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 連結業績予想及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 中東情勢の緊迫化による原油価格上昇下での石油製品の安定供給と適切なコスト転嫁により、営業利益等が前回予想を上回る見込み

summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥136/share (FY3/27 full year) from ¥130 guidance: mid-term ¥68 (+¥3), year-end ¥68 (+¥3). Payout ratio not disclosed. 12th consecutive increase. Revision driven by upgraded FY3/27 net income guidance (¥12,050M vs ¥11,000M prior) on better-than-expected oil product margins despite Middle East supply tensions.
summary_jp: 年間配当を¥136/株に修正（前回¥130予想）：中間¥68（+¥3）、期末¥68（+¥3）。12期連続増配。FY3/27純利益上方修正（¥12,050M vs ¥11,000M）に基づく。
tag_en: Dividend Hike - ¥136/share (FY3/27) vs ¥130 prior guidance - 12th consecutive year
tag_jp: 増配 - ¥136/株 (通期) vs ¥130前回予想 - 12期連続増配

doc_title_en: Notification regarding revision (increase) of dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2026

key_facts.reason_jp: 長期経営方針における株主還元方針と当期業績等を総合的に勘案

summary_en: Final dividend raised ¥10/share to ¥65 (from ¥55 prior forecast). Combined with interim dividend of ¥50, annual dividend reaches ¥115/share for FY3/26, marking 11th consecutive year of dividend increases. Next fiscal year annual dividend forecast at ¥130/share (interim ¥65).
summary_jp: 期末配当を10円増配し65円に修正（前回予想55円）。中間配当50円と合わせた年間配当は115円/株で、11期連続増配となる見通し。次期年間配当予想は130円/株（中間65円）。
tag_en: Dividend hike - ¥65/share final (¥115 annual) - FY3/26 - 11th consecutive increase
tag_jp: 増配 - 期末65円（年間115円）- 2026年3月期 - 11期連続増配
